notes.title: Small Patch - v0.9.8f
notes.notes:
Just published a small patch before diving into major changes next week. You’ll notice some visual updates in combat mostly. Hopefully this fixes most of the issues we were seeing. Let me know if anything else pops up!

Changelog:
[list]
[*]Health and Guard bars: once it passes 50, change the size increments color.
[*]More Skill room: on the combat bar, increase the capacity for more skills.
[*]Party Screen: Skills are now in a content panel.
[*]New shape for Traits, Racials and other Skills that don't count as Skills.
[*]When players resist arrest, the group reputation will not suffer another hit.
[*][FIX] Seal items are now Tier 5 instead of Tier 4.
[*][BUG] Spine shenanigans: textures were exported 4096 x 4096 and not 2048 x 2048 causing texture scaling issues.
[/list]

notes.title: 🛡️ Citizenship Update & QoL Improvements ⚔️
notes.notes:
The Citizenship Upgrade is here! 🎉 Now your group of adventurers can visit the Tavern and choose to become a Citizen of the town, unlocking some cool new privileges:
[list]
[*]Luxury Inn: Rest in style at an expensive inn, doubling your recovery rate.
[*]Banquet: Celebrate with a full stomach for extra bonuses.
[*]Fund Building: Help shape the town’s growth and unlock the facilities you need.
[*]New Hamlet: Build a new town nearby and expand your territory.
[/list]
In addition, I’ve made several tweaks and improvements based on your feedback:[list]
[*]Meteoric Bow now deals splash damage.
[*]Dialogue Streamlining: Internal changes made to prepare for the upcoming Mod Support update.
[*]Map Interaction: Pressing Esc now clears the MapQuery. If no query is active, it opens the Menu.
[*]Status Change: Boost Armor now increases Armor by +2 and removes the Damaged Armor status.
[*]Combat Bar Update: Added action indicator for better clarity during combat.
[*]Dual Wilder:[list]
[*]Offhand weapons now deal half the damage of the corresponding hand weapon of the same tier.
[*]Adjusted damage amplitudes to better balance two-handed and hand/offhand weapons:[list]
[*]Two-Handed:[list]
[*].10 → .25
[*].25 → .33
[*].50 → .50[/list]
[*]Hand/Offhand:[list]
[*].50 → .33[/list][/list]
[*]Big Weapons Training Skill: Minimum Damage +15%.[/list]
[/list]
I’ve also been working on the final touches for Mod Support and it’s almost ready! Expect more news on that soon.

Cheers! =]

notes.title: Some Changes and a Fix
notes.notes:
Starting the week strong with a fast update! I was already cooking a few improvements and the QA already gave the green light, so I decided to bundle them with a critical bug fix. This patch brings balance tweaks, QoL upgrades, some love to towns and Evil Centers and a few spicy skill changes.

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Party Screen: Click 'R' or 'S' to jump straight to the Relations or Skills menu.
[*] Overseer Routine: Every in-game day, the map now checks if each race has a Town. If not, one will be created.
[*] Pan on Edge: New option to toggle edge-panning on or off in the Options menu.
[*] Skill XP: Arcane Traits and Arcane Focus now grant extra skill uses for Mastery progression.
[*] Multiple Master Skills: Characters can now hold multiple Master Skills, as long as they aren’t in a Master Quest.
[*] Town Shop – Balance:
[list]
[*] Reduced base sell modifiers.
[*] Town Shop Events: cap the buy/sell bonus to 50%.
[*] UI tweaks to fit more buttons on the left panel.
[/list]
[*] Evil Centers: Difficulty now scales with your party’s level. Good luck! XD
[*] New Game+: On starting a new game, choose to keep your current party or make a new one. Pick a fresh world either way.
[*] Skill Changes:
[list]
[*] Shadow Move: Teleport (Speed x2)
[*] Far Shadow Move: Speed x3
[*] Dodging Shadow Move: Guard Bonus (Speed x2)
[*] Defensive Shadow Move: Guard Bonus (Speed x2)
[*] Black Magic: Now have Drain 2.
[*] Hold Crowd & Hold Horde: Now are friendly fire.
[/list]
[*] Legendaries: Can now be modified.
[*] Illusory Mage (Master Skill): Added skills: Passive True Sight, Mind Leak, Counterspell.
[*] Bug Fix: Fixed crash caused by Vine spells.
[/list]

Thanks for all the bug reports and suggestions, mates! You're helping me a ton to make the best game I can. I really do have the best players I could ask for! Stay tuned for the next updates, I'm cooking something big! ^_~


Cheers!

notes.title: Event System Update!
notes.notes:
Adventurers, a major update has arrived! We’re introducing a brand-new Event System, bringing dynamic encounters and richer storytelling to Endless RPG: Untold Tales.

Now, many events can occur during your playthrough, influenced by your party composition, weather, biome, and even the current moon phase! These events can be expanded in future updates and are fully customizable by players. Since they are configured via JSON, a complete document with instructions and in-game examples is available for easy modification.

Changelog:
[list]
[*]Event Engine and new events
[*]Exchanged Bleed for Drain on Bat Swarm Spell
[*]Improved Party dialogues
[*]Easier Tutorial and Early Game
[*]Reducing Demo time to 25 in-game days
[*]Reduce XP needed for level 3 to 4 in 10% (from 1500 to 1350)
[*]Skill name change “Swift Sneak Attack” -> “Deep Sneak Attack”
[*][BUG] On Dungeons, Darkness surface is too small and doesn’t cover all the screen
[*][BUG] If quest is active and watched and start a new game, old quest from another party is still visible on screen
[*][BUG] On Dungeons, Darkness surface is too small and doesn’t cover all the screen
[*][BUG] Town Shop, negative cost depending on events
[*][BUG] Spacebar not unpausing the game
[*][FIX] Reduce the damage caused by events
[/list]

notes.title: Endless RPG Update: Exciting Things Ahead!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I wanted to share a quick update on the progress of Endless RPG. While I was aiming for a September release, a few things have taken a bit longer than expected—especially the final dialogues for the Evil Centers. But don’t worry, I’m working hard to get everything just right!

On the bright side, I’m making great strides with the Tutorials and Quest System, which are crucial parts of the game. I’ll be rolling out updated versions on itch.io as I continue to polish things up, so you can still dive in and see the progress firsthand and for free.

I’ll also be putting more effort into marketing to get the word out about Endless RPG. While this might not be the best place to ask for help, any support from you is always appreciated! I will make some videos (long and short) as soon as I can.

Thanks so much for your patience and love. I’m committed to delivering the best experience possible, and I’m excited for what’s to come.

Cheers!
